departures_from_mindmix.audio_window: 0.8 s ([-0.2, 0.6) s around the anchor, inside its 5 s segment) instead of 2 s; wav2vec2 sees 39 frames
departures_from_mindmix.batches: person-homogeneous query blocks of the shared ALN4.1 episode stream; support blocks unused
departures_from_mindmix.eeg_backbone: common CBraMod Stage1 (pretrained_full), three 400 ms crops per anchor, instead of the released LaBraM-style encoder
departures_from_mindmix.eeg_readout: channel-aware LN + Linear(64*200 -> 256) + GELU + LN per slot (project default; MindMix: channel mean -> Linear(200, 256))
departures_from_mindmix.loss: official one-directional ClipLoss (EEG rows), logit scale fixed at log(1/0.07) as in MindMix Stage 2; not symmetrised
departures_from_mindmix.lr: source-only calibration 1e-4 vs 3e-4 over 1 000 updates with the common dev ridge probe (CALRA); PROJ_NCE inherits
departures_from_mindmix.optimizer: ALN4.1 source recipe (AdamW wd 1e-4 on matrices, cosine, clip 5, no warmup, 10 000 updates of 2 x 32 query anchors) instead of MindMix Stage 2 (AdamW wd 0.05, 10-epoch warmup, cosine, lr 1e-4, batch 32)
departures_from_mindmix.slot_pooling: learned gate logits a (init 0 = mean pooling), as every Table 6 arm; frozen readouts use q0 = softmax(a)
departures_from_mindmix.specaugment: wav2vec2 mask_time_min_masks 1 (released 2): masked fraction ~0.26 at 39 frames (released config: ~0.44 at 39 frames, ~0.19 at MindMix 99 frames)
